Hi Tara —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can do this; below is our proposed package and timeline.

Planned deliverables (initial package):
- caiq-answers-v2.docx (draft mapping: CAIQ/CCM IDs -> artifact names and owners)
- access-log-sample.csv (redacted sample, 14-day rolling window to avoid over-sharing)

Sampling & redaction approach:
- We'll provide a 14-day sample by default (to balance reviewability and privacy). If you need a full 30-day slice, we can provide it via a secure presigned S3 link after legal approval.
- PII redaction: IPs will be masked to CIDR /64-equivalent hashes, user identifiers replaced with consistent pseudonyms, and any email addresses redacted unless explicitly needed.

Locations & access:
- Primary artifacts will be staged in a restricted Drive folder (link below) and the full exports will be uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/caiq/greenwave-health/ (presigned link on request).

Timeline:
- Preliminary package (docx + 14-day CSV sample) by Thu Nov 12 EOD PST.
- Full 30-day export available after legal sign-off (预计 within 48 hours after approval).

Next steps for your legal team: please review the draft mapping and sample CSV for sufficiency. Rishi — can you advise on any legal language GreenWave will want in the chain-of-custody or affidavit? Priyom — can you confirm the exact artifact paths we'll deliver and whether any logs contain masked PII by default?

Internal attachments (for your review): caiq-answers-v2.docx (draft), coc-redaction-guidance.pdf.
